_meta.note: Pinned provider prices per million tokens. cache_write is the 5-minute-TTL write premium rate (Anthropic bills cache writes at 1.25x input INSTEAD of the input rate; cache reads at 0.1x). OpenAI-style providers (OpenAI, OpenRouter) report cached tokens inside prompt_tokens (prompt_includes_cache_read: true) and have no write premium, so cache_write is 0 to avoid double-charging writes already counted in prompt_tokens. A counted round must re-capture this file at freeze time; every run record carries its sha256.
_meta.openrouter_variance: OpenRouter routes each model across multiple upstream providers whose prices differ; entries marked pricing_varies_by_provider pin the DEFAULT-route list price from the OpenRouter models API at capture time, with the observed spread recorded. For a counted round, pin the route (OpenRouter account-level provider preferences, or a provider-suffixed slug) so the pinned price is the billed price, and re-capture here.
_meta.openai_long_context: GPT-5.6 prices below are the short-context tier; inputs beyond the long-context threshold (~272K) bill at roughly double. Benchmark tasks stay well under it; a round that does not must add the long-context rates.

sources.anthropic: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/pricing (Sonnet 5 pinned at the introductory $2/$10 rate, effective through 2026-08-31 - re-pin after that date)
